strategies.instructions: Explicitly select the Google-hosted Gmail Developer Preview for its documented search/thread, draft and label operations. The documented tools do not include sending mail; draft creation leaves sending to Gmail. Use the retained Streamable HTTP endpoint only with the host-owned OAuth binding. Observe the actual current tool schemas and bind only authorized operations. If this route is unavailable or denied, report that result; do not silently switch to REST.
unresolved_details: Preview eligibility, account consent, host client registration, current schemas and owner-authenticated readiness are not established by this bundle.
The hosted implementation is mutable. No Toolkit/Google live operation, revocation, isolation or deployment support assessment is claimed.

strategies.instructions: Explicitly select the repository Gmail operation library in sdk/python or sdk/typescript for one-page message listing, selected message retrieval and an authorized MIME send. Read the matching GMAIL.md and this version's SUPPORT.md for exact local artifact availability and transport contracts; do not assume a public package release. The host supplies the selected authenticated client, API base and account. Preserve opaque pagination and nested message data. Send the exact approved MIME bytes once; an uncertain result is not permission to retry. This is a separately selected REST strategy, never a fallback from MCP refusal. Compose the existing activation and credential owners before publishing agent tools.
unresolved_details: A host adapter must bind the selected local SDK artifact, account, operations, schemas and lifecycle to the existing service-connector export. The operation libraries are not an activated agent tool surface.
The host must supply its own authenticated client, OAuth registration and credential lifecycle, scoped authorization and any send approval/reconciliation. This recipe supplies none of those owners.
Only repository source and recorded local build artifacts are available here; no public PyPI/npm release or live Gmail conformance is established.

known_exports.description: Selected Gmail account operations; MCP preview and REST have different coverage. Only owner-verified operations may be published.

assessments.scope: Retained recipe and official documentation inspection. Local SDK protocol tests do not establish host activation, authenticated Google access or live service readiness.
